children: Generali CEO Philippe Donnet tells a press briefing:
NEW STRATEGY WILL BE UNVEILED AT THE END OF 2027 OR AT THE BEGINNING OF 2028
COMPANY HAS NO PLANS TO SELL BANCA GENERALI
HAPPY THAT TWO IMPORTANT FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS ARE OUR SHAREHOLDERS, IT'S IMPORTANT THAT COMPANY REMAINS ITALIAN, INTERNATIONAL AND INDIPENDENT
NO WORRIES ABOUT THE POSSIBILITY THAT INTESA BECOMES OUR IMPORTANT SHAREHOLDER
